metadata.description: Tekton — methodologies for C/Si collaboration. Two channels: stable entries track main, Beta entries track beta.

plugins.name: chiron
plugins.description: Chiron — methodological companion for the tekton corpus.

plugins.name: kairos
plugins.description: Kairos — attention allocation guardian. Dispatchable subagent or main-thread persona for workspaces that hold a KAIROS/ state.

plugins.name: kyklos
plugins.description: Kyklos — the unified cycle of learning and production. Three profiles sharing one trunk: Elasis (swift forge), Anabasis (production refinement), Organon (knowledge refinement).

plugins.name: chiron-beta
plugins.description: Beta channel — Chiron ahead of stable. Same components as chiron, so install one or the other, never both.

plugins.name: kairos-beta
plugins.description: Beta channel — Kairos ahead of stable. Same components as kairos, so install one or the other, never both.

plugins.name: kyklos-beta
plugins.description: Beta channel — Kyklos ahead of stable. Same components as kyklos, so install one or the other, never both.
